claim_verbatim: Insurance premiums $0.102 per vehicle mile in 2024 (4.5% of $2.260/mile total); 36% per-mile increase over 8 years (ATRI 2025)

discrepancy_resolution.flagged_discrepancy: Web summaries returned 8.7 cents/mile vs claimed $0.102/mile
discrepancy_resolution.resolution: The $0.102/mile figure is confirmed as the 2024 ATRI 2025 report figure; the 8.7 cents figure likely refers to a different reporting year (2022 or earlier) or a different fleet-size segment. Multiple independent secondary sources citing the primary ATRI PDF all confirm $0.102/mile for 2024.
discrepancy_resolution.coverage_scope: ATRI's insurance cost line item includes auto liability AND cargo insurance but explicitly excludes physical damage coverage. It is an industry-wide average across all participating carriers, not segmented by fleet size in the headline figure.
discrepancy_resolution.trend_clarification: The 36% per-mile increase over 8 years refers specifically to 'trucking auto liability premiums' per mile (per ATRI's November 2025 press release). The baseline 8-year window ends in 2024, implying the start year is approximately 2016.

claim_validation.coverage_type: Includes auto liability and cargo insurance; excludes physical damage. The 36% figure from ATRI's Nov 2025 press release is described as applying to 'auto liability premiums' specifically — the operational costs report combines auto liability + cargo.
claim_validation.fleet_size_segmentation: The $0.102/mile is an industry-wide average; ATRI does publish segmented data by fleet size in the full report, but this headline figure is not restricted to a particular segment.
claim_validation.prior_year_for_comparison: $0.099/mile in 2023 (reported in the 2024 ATRI update), confirming the 3.0% increase to $0.102/mile in 2024.
